subject: GreenLane onboarding — request for PO exemption and expedited setup
content:
From: Julia Park <julia@greenlane.io>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-10 09:14 PDT
Subject: New supplier onboarding + PO question

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're excited to get GreenLane Analytics set up as a Redwood vendor so we can begin the trial integration next week. Quick question on your side: our procurement team usually issues a PO to validate budgets. Is a Purchase Order required to start the initial paid trial (estimated $3,800) or can we proceed with an invoice/credit-card setup while we finish onboarding?

Attached: GreenLane_W9.pdf (attachment: GreenLane_W9.pdf application/pdf)

Thanks,
Julia Park
Vendor Success | GreenLane Analytics
(julia@greenlane.io)

---
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Julia Park <julia@greenlane.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-10 10:03 PDT
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding + PO question

Hi Julia —

Appreciate the materials. For Redwood, our PO policy requires a PO for purchases over $5,000. Since the trial is ~$3.8k, it falls below the PO threshold in principle. That said, we do have exceptions and some accounting preferences for vendors (billing cadence, tax docs). To avoid delays in setting up billing, I'm looping in Monica (Procurement) and Marcus (Finance) to confirm we can onboard GreenLane without a PO and proceed with standard invoicing.

Monica / Marcus — we have GreenLane wanting to start next week. They provided a W-9. Can we approve onboarding with invoice terms for the pilot? Laura, tagging you for any legal/SOW input if the SOW changes billing terms.

Next steps I'd propose:
- Monica: quick vendor onboarding check (tax & KYC)
- Marcus: confirm invoicing/card acceptance + any holdback requirements
- If either of you prefer a PO, please let us know ASAP so we can request one from GreenLane.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

---
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-10 11:27 PDT
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding + PO question

Stephanie —

I reviewed the W-9; GreenLane looks clean from a tax perspective. A couple of quick asks before I mark them as active in our vendor portal:
- We need a completed supplier profile in our onboarding form (company address, ACH details, remit-to). I sent GreenLane the portal link.
- We prefer a signed SOW for any services above trial scope; can they send a short SOW?

Given the amount is under $5k, we can onboard them without a PO. However, for Friday provisioning I need either:
1) Confirmation of invoicing terms (Net 30) and remit details, or
2) A temporary payment method (card on file) to avoid provisioning hold.

I'll move forward on KYC once the supplier profile and remit data are provided.

- Monica
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

---
From: Julia Park <julia@greenlane.io>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Benson <tomb@greenlane.io>
Date: 2026-05-11 08:42 PDT
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding + PO question

Thanks, Monica —

We're uploading the vendor profile now. Attached is our proposed SOW for the pilot and the remit/ACH info (GreenLane_SOW_v1.docx) (attachment: GreenLane_SOW_v1.docx application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document). Our finance team can accept Net 30 invoices. If you prefer to provision against a card temporarily, we can provide a credit card on file for the demonstration period.

Also sending the procurement contact here if you need a PO later: procure@greenlane.io.

Best,
Julia

---
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-12 16:02 PDT
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding + PO question

Team —

I've reviewed the SOW and W-9. Since the pilot value is below our $5k PO threshold and GreenLane is providing the necessary tax/docs, Finance approves onboarding without a PO under these conditions:
- Billing on Net 30 invoices with VAT/local tax handling confirmed (they confirmed Net 30)
- Redwood will hold payment rights until SOW milestone 1 is delivered for production credits if we choose to apply credits (standard clause)
- For any increase beyond $5k or multi-quarter commitments, a PO will be required and we should re-evaluate vendor terms.

Monica: please enable vendor in the portal and choose "Invoice" as payment method. Laura, if Legal wants a minor SOW clause for milestone holdback, please advise; otherwise sign-off from Finance is okay.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

---
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Julia Park <julia@greenlane.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-12 16:12 PDT
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding + PO question

Julia —

Thanks — green light from Finance and Procurement to onboard GreenLane without a PO for the pilot. Monica will activate the vendor record and set invoicing terms to Net 30. Laura, will you loop back if you want a one-line SOW amendment for holdback?

Next steps for GreenLane:
- Complete the portal profile (done)
- Confirm remit/ACH info (done)
- Redwood Procurement activates vendor and marks payment method: Invoice (Net 30)
- Tech team schedules integration kickoff for 5/18

If anything changes or the scope increases above $5k, we'll request a PO. Welcome aboard.

Cheers,
Stephanie

(Attachments: GreenLane_W9.pdf, GreenLane_SOW_v1.docx)
